name: canvas-readonly-mcp
description: Ask what changed in your Canvas courses and search every lecture slide and PDF. Read-only: it can't submit, post or change anything.
long_description:
A read-only server for Canvas LMS. It only ever sends GET requests to Canvas, so it can't submit, post or change anything. It works with any Canvas instance and any role (students, TAs, teachers).

Ask things like "What changed in my courses since yesterday?", "What's due in the next two weeks?", "Summarize the lab 2 instructions" or "Where did we cover dynamic programming?". It reads the text of PDFs, slide decks and Word documents linked from your courses, and keeps daily snapshots so changes and full-text search are instant.

Your token is stored in your system keychain and only sent to your Canvas. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Instructure. "Canvas" is a trademark of Instructure, Inc.
